raw_semantic_inspection.grade_scope: Original blinded experimental annotation, not old textbook review. All table photo prompt/gold/output/grade reason pairs were read against actual rendered source photos; all voice systems/rubrics/typed+ASR outputs were read. Recorded counts are the original frozen rubric-based scores, not newly generated model evaluations.

independent_findings: Source photo gold examples and queried spatial/object facts correspond to the observed original photos; narrow questions accept concise synonyms and reject false additions. The source image names train_.../test_... are upstream dataset names, while manifest rows used here have split=validation.
The table counters use complete-and-correct under the frozen semantic rubric; they do not mean a phrase-match classifier, pure recognition score, or universal accuracy.

Traditional-Chinese instruction is part of voice systems. Candidate employee-communication answers fail language compliance; platform-linking answers fail intended task. This supports a drop on the typed-reference route independent of ASR errors.
The voice platform-linking ASR input changes 连接 to 点击. It is identically supplied to all three candidates and is scored against the original spoken intent.

Manual judgments accept equivalents (orange/yellow cave lighting, broad column-like rock shapes) and reject unsupported identities/intent, wrong spatial/count claims or wrong requested language. Fine-grained semantic decisions remain annotated rubric judgments.

The frozen gates are project-specific design choices. The 2026-10-04 lower-LR protocol precedes this follow-up training/validation but explicitly was informed by earlier v4 validation; no claim of preregistration before all v4 experiments is made.
Base fallback contains six truncated chat answers as well as semantic errors. Its selection does not establish all-EOS eligibility or universal capability.
training_scope: Read optimizer-only-LoRA contract and raw history/checkpoint/sample leaves. The base frozen sample equality is evidence for sampled parameters, not a new full-weight equality experiment. No weights retained, no training, model loading, model download or fresh mature-model scores.
